status: Explicit shared game calibration, not historical food-production estimates. Population evaluates the candidate but is not a formula input or a location-specific target.

extent_guard.interpretation: Conservative uncertainty allowance for extra inferred works in sparsely cultivated systems. Below 1% reconstructed cultivation, additional cultivated and water-served extent may each expand by at most the existing cultivated extent. The guard tapers to no restriction at 5%. Managed and intensive classifications retain their previous allowance. These thresholds are scenario assumptions, not observed medieval rates. Source-supported land and water works remain intact; population and fill are reporting only.

inheritance.interpretation: Shared starting-infrastructure scenario on evidence of existing cultivation. Agricultural-system classes come from the existing historical regional assessments. Extent is HYDE/LUH-related evidence, not independent of historical demography. Fractions are game assignments, not surveyed 1300 adoption rates.
inheritance.status: Retired 2026-09-19 for the targets: no remaining potential is pulled into the starting scenario. Starting improvements now represent evidenced 1300 works only (HYDE/LUH cultivation, served irrigation, water-management evidence); the previous activation shares are kept above for reference and can be restored for a diagnostic build.

support_conversion.formula: game = game_scale * G(s;r), G(s;r) = max(s, r * (s/r)^exponent), G(0;r)=0
support_conversion.interpretation: Compress the extreme low-support tail in game units. Reference values use the source density's units for dimensional consistency; they are calibration anchors, not measured crop or pastoral yields. Apply to baseline, inherited starting and maximum support on the native grid. Preserve ordering, unchanged high support and the bounded location multiplier. game_scale is one global factor applied to base, starting and maximum game support after conversion; together with the exponent it is the only fill-calibration knob. Choose it with scripts/calibrate_fill.py against the configured fill targets; population evaluates candidates but never enters the formula.
support_conversion.game_scale_status: 2026-09-19: chosen from scripts/calibrate_fill.py; settled Old-World rural median fill ~0.33 with ~11% rural over-capacity. A 0.75 median is unreachable without >30% over-capacity, so the fill target was lowered to 0.35 / 0.10.

evaluation.interpretation: Game coverage diagnostics, not a claim that residual shortages are historically justified or that population growth is balanced.

limitations: Raises base support as well as capacity from improvements; cannot be interpreted as literal new hectares or calories.
No population-type, population-count, rank, owner or individual location exception enters the calculation.
No groundwater, new crop yield, additional river runoff or land is added to the physical ledger.
Equal-area subdivision bias remains. Future integration must balance food coefficients against these game capacities.
Inherited opportunity is bounded by the simultaneous physical maximum; actual medieval infrastructure coverage remains uncertain.
